summary: Frontend-only responsive layout regression test for /manage/* console (ManageLayout drawer fix). Tested mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) viewports as admin. All 5 acceptance criteria PASSED: (1) sidebar off-canvas on mobile with hamburger visible in top bar, no content overlap; (2) hamburger opens drawer w/ backdrop + X close; both close paths work; (3) nav item click navigates AND closes drawer; (4) desktop shows fixed sidebar (x=12, w=231), hamburger hidden, main offset by 256px; all 8 nav links (My Services, My Profile, Bookings, Overview, Providers, Services, Activities, Societies) route correctly; (5) regression across pages on both viewports keeps main content at x=0 (mobile) / x=256 (desktop) with no overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: ManageLayout.jsx is clean, small (~100 lines), uses proper Tailwind lg breakpoint (1024px), transform translate-x with transition, correct z-index layering (top bar z-30, backdrop z-40, sidebar z-50). No issues.
Minor nit (non-blocking): sidebar could add aria-hidden={!open} on <lg for accessibility; hamburger could set aria-expanded. Not a functional bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ManageLayout responsive drawer fix verified end-to-end. testids present: menu-open-button, menu-close-button, menu-backdrop, nav-provider-{services,profile,bookings}, nav-admin-{overview,providers,services,categories,societies}, back-to-app-button. Breakpoint = Tailwind lg (1024px). Mobile <1024: off-canvas w/ backdrop; Desktop >=1024: fixed sidebar w-64 + main lg:ml-64. All good.
rca of the issue: Original bug: fixed w-64 sidebar with main ml-64 caused sidebar to render at fixed left position while main content also offset — on narrow viewports sidebar overlapped content and had no dismissal. Fix: introduced open state + Tailwind responsive classes: sidebar uses `-translate-x-full` by default and `lg:translate-x-0`; main uses `lg:ml-64` (no offset below lg); mobile top bar with hamburger + backdrop + close button added; nav item onClick closes drawer for smooth UX. Verified: mobile bbox shows sidebar at x=-244 (hidden) by default, x=12 (visible) when opened; main at x=0 (mobile) / x=256 (desktop).
